# TeaTapler

> A luxury tea maison offering curated single-origin teas, heritage blends, bespoke atelier pairings with Sidr honey, monthly membership tiers, gift cards, and private tasting events. Tagline: "Indulge in the Elegance of Tea".

## About

TeaTapler sources rare teas from master growers and delivers them with editorial storytelling. The brand serves three distinct audiences: single-tin buyers, monthly members, and corporate gifting clients. Everything is sold directly via teatapler.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://teatapler.com/): Luxury tea maison overview, featured teas, brand story
- [Shop](https://teatapler.com/shop.html): Browse single-origin teas by collection (Classics $42-$95, Heritage Reserve $95-$180, Atelier pairings)
- [Membership](https://teatapler.com/subscribe.html): Monthly subscriptions — Classic $45/mo, Reserve $95/mo, Atelier $180/mo; yearly billing saves 10%
- [Gift Cards](https://teatapler.com/gift-cards.html): Digital gift cards from $50 to $1,000 delivered with personal note
- [Events](https://teatapler.com/events.html): Private tasting events, brewing rituals, corporate gifting experiences

## Products

- **Imperial Dawn** — black tea, full-bodied, 50g/100g tins
- **Emerald Whisper** — green tea, delicate floral notes
- **Crimson Veil** — oolong, honey-roasted character
- **Golden Ember** — assam black, strong morning blend
- **Azure Bloom** — jasmine green, perfumed
- **Noir Silhouette** — pu-erh, earthy and aged
- **Sakura Mist** — cherry blossom white tea (Heritage Reserve)
- **Golden Hour Blend** — chai spiced black tea (Heritage Reserve)
- **Luna Chai** — masala chai blend (Heritage Reserve)

## Memberships

- **Classic** — $45/month, $480/year. 3 teas per month, free domestic shipping, cancel anytime.
- **Reserve** — $95/month, $1,020/year. 4 rare teas per month, handwritten tasting notes, priority event access, free global shipping.
- **Atelier** — $180/month, $1,920/year. Bespoke monthly blend, Sidr honey pairing, quarterly private tasting, concierge access, complimentary gifting.

## FAQ

### What is TeaTapler?
TeaTapler is a luxury tea maison offering curated single-origin teas, heritage blends, and bespoke atelier pairings with Sidr honey.

### How do I brew green tea?
Use 75-80°C water (not boiling). Steep 2-3 minutes. 1 teaspoon per cup. Second steep at 85°C for 1 minute.

### How do I brew black tea?
Use 95-100°C water. Steep 3-5 minutes. 1 teaspoon per cup. Add milk after steeping if desired.

### Where do you ship?
Globally. Classic orders ship within 2-3 business days domestically; international 5-10 days. Reserve and Atelier members receive complimentary global shipping.

### Do you offer gift wrapping?
Yes. All orders over $100 include signature emerald-and-gold presentation. Gift notes can be added at checkout.

### What is the return policy?
Unopened tins may be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Opened tea is final sale due to quality standards.

### Can I pause my subscription?
Yes. Members can pause for up to 3 months or cancel anytime from their account dashboard. No commitment required.

### Is caffeine content listed?
Each product page shows caffeine level (low/medium/high). Herbal and decaf options are clearly labeled.

### How do I attend a tasting event?
Browse upcoming events on the Events page. RSVP with a deposit; seats are limited. Reserve and Atelier members get priority access.

### What pairs well with green tea?
Light fare: sashimi, delicate pastries, white chocolate. Light Sidr honey complements jasmine and green teas beautifully.
